title: Release updates and beta news
description: Follow Vector OS release updates and beta news. Email updates are optional; check the current signup availability and privacy information.
html:
Follow the build

Stay in the loop.

One weekly email about Vector OS, new recordings and release news.

No product account is created. Joining does not guarantee early access.

See recorded examples

Your inbox. Your choice.

We collect your name, email and any optional company, role and tool interests to manage the waitlist and send your requested updates. Registration and consent are stored in a private Google Sheet. Your details are not published or sold. Every newsletter includes an unsubscribe option.
